name: UI Ultra Marathon 2026
short_description: UI Ultra Marathon 2026 is a night road race on Saturday 5 December 2026 on a 7 km loop at Universitas Indonesia, Depok, with a marathon, half marathon, 70 km and 7 km.
ai_summary: UI Ultra Marathon 2026 is a night race on Saturday 5 December 2026 on a 7 km loop around the Universitas Indonesia campus in Depok, West Java. The marathon (six loops, 7-hour cut-off), half marathon (three loops, 3.5-hour cut-off), 70 km ultra and 7 km all flag off from 7.30pm, with a 7 km team race at sunrise on Sunday 6 December. Individual entries cost IDR 300,000 to IDR 1,400,000, and entrants can add a donation to Dana Abadi UI, the university endowment that funds scholarships.

core_facts.venue: Universitas Indonesia campus, Depok (7 km loop)
core_facts.organizer: UI Ultra, supported by ILUNI FEB UI (Universitas Indonesia economics and business alumni)

faqs.question: When do the marathon and half marathon run at UI Ultra Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Both run on the night of Saturday 5 December 2026, flagging off at 7.30pm WIB with the 70 km ultra. The 7 km individual race starts at 7.45pm, and a 7 km team race for groups of ten runs at 6.30am on Sunday 6 December.

faqs.question: What is the course?
faqs.answer: A 7 km loop on the Universitas Indonesia campus in Depok, just south of Jakarta. The half marathon is three loops with a 3.5-hour cut-off, the marathon six loops with a 7-hour cut-off and the 70 km ultra ten loops with a 12-hour cut-off. The campus is next to the Universitas Indonesia and Pondok Cina commuter-rail stations.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to enter?
faqs.answer: Individual fees are IDR 700,000 for the half marathon, IDR 1,000,000 for the marathon, IDR 1,400,000 for the 70 km and IDR 300,000 for the 7 km. A five-person 70 km relay and the ten-person sunrise team race cost IDR 3,000,000 per team.
